what: Parameters of the four-in-a-row model for the film's run: the medians of the 200 fits of the opponent-scaling model to the human-versus-human experiment (40 participants, five cross-validation groups each) of van Opheusden et al. (2023, Nature), in the order of TreeSearch's parameters. The active scaling constant of those fits has a median of 0.9999; the model's build fixes it at 1.
source: https://osf.io/n2xjm/, model_fits_opponent_scaling.csv (https://osf.io/download/byw7f/), rows with experiment == human-vs-human
